|descr= Subtracts numbers or arrays from each another, negates a number. For arrays also see [[deleteAt]] and [[deleteRange]].
{{Feature|arma3|In Arma 3 it is possible to subtract nested arrays.}}

|s1= numberA [[-]] numberB

|p1= numberA: [[Number]]

|p2= numberB: [[Number]]

|r1= [[Number]]

|s2= [[-]] numberA

|p21= numberA: [[Number]]

|r2= [[Number]] - the negative of ''numberA''

|s3= arrayA [[-]] arrayB

|p41= arrayA: [[Array]] of [[Anything]]

|p42= arrayB: [[Array]] of [[Anything]]

|r3= [[Array]] of [[Anything]]

|x1= <sqf>_result = 10 - 7; // result is 3</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>
_numA = 4;
_numB = -_numA; // result is -4
_numB = -_numB; // result is  4
</sqf>

|x3= <sqf>_result = [1, 2, 2, player, "String"] - [2, player, player, "String"]; // _result is [1]</sqf>

|x4= <sqf>_result = [0, [0], [[0]]] - [0]; // [[0], [[0]]]</sqf>

|x5= <sqf>
_result = [0, [0], [[0]]] - [[0]];		// [0, [<nowiki/>[0]]]	- Since {{arma3}}
_result = [0, [0], [[0]]] - [[[0]]];	// [0, [0]]		- Since {{arma3}}
</sqf>
